name: Frost Arrows
description: Arrows prepared with alchemical or magical frost charge for chilling impact effects.
narrative_effects: Supports chill, brittle-surface, or slowing-impact framing where frost effects are plausible.
Usually loses its prepared charge once fired.

mechanical_effect.trigger: fired from a compatible bow at a target or surface where chilling, brittleness, or slowing impact is plausible
mechanical_effect.applies_to: checks to exploit frost effects: chilling impact, brittle surfaces, exposed mechanisms, or slowing pressure delivered by a bow shot
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: targets or materials unaffected by cold; ordinary accuracy beyond the frost-delivery purpose; situations where chilling would not help
